title: Syncthing
descript: Syncthing is a continuous file synchronization program. It synchronizes files between your NAS and other devices directly, with encrypted transport and no central cloud. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container; configuration and synchronized data stay in the application data folder, and the web UI is served on port 8384.
release_note: 1. First release: Syncthing 2.1.7 from Docker Hub, x86_64 + aarch64, non-root.
important: Open the web UI and set a GUI username/password on first use. Add your devices and folders in the UI; by default only the web port 8384 is published, so LAN sync uses discovery/relay - for direct sync you would need the sync ports (22000/tcp+udp, 21027/udp), which this package does not publish. Config and data live in DockerAppData/syncthingdocker. Back them up before uninstalling with data removal. Needs DockerEngine. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-hk.descript: Syncthing 是一個持續檔案同步工具，可以讓 NAS 與其他裝置之間直接同步檔案，傳輸加密、不經過中心雲。本應用使用 Docker Hub 官方鏡像並以非 root 使用者運行；設定與同步資料都保存在應用資料目錄，網頁介面監聽 8384。

data_notes: `config` holds the device ID, certificates, GUI credentials and folder database; `data` is the default synchronized folder. Copying both folders preserves the device identity and all synced files.
design_notes: **Non-root.** Runs as `1000:1000`; verified on real hardware.
**Two volumes, one web port.** `/var/syncthing/config` + `/var/syncthing/data`; only 8384 is published.
**Fixed image tag**, Docker Hub only, no privileged mode, no host network, no Docker socket.
limitations: Only the web UI port is published. Direct LAN sync needs 22000/tcp+udp and 21027/udp; without them Syncthing falls back to discovery and relays, which is slower.
The web UI has no default password. Set a GUI username/password immediately; otherwise anyone who can reach port 8384 can manage the instance.
Plain HTTP on the LAN; do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.

runtime_files.purpose: device identity, certificates, GUI credentials and folder database
runtime_files.lifecycle: never overwritten; without it the device identity changes
